csv_project_name: Consultant for Yuba City Central City Specific Plan
csv_scope_of_work: The City of Yuba City (City), located in Sutter County, California, is requesting proposals from qualified consultants to provide consultant services for updating the existing Central City Specific Plan and preparing Objective Design Standards. The Objective Design Standards will serve as the foundation for guiding citywide developments in alignment with the city's strategic planning and development goals. This initiative aims to streamline the approval process for housing developments while ensuring high standards for sustainability, community involvement, and architectural integrity. The Objective Design Standards will streamline the approval process for all new housing projects, including multi-family and mixed-use developments. This initiative will establish clear, objective, and quantifiable design guidelines that ensure consistency and transparency in project reviews.
